title: Pause > Quit during the victory/defeat staging shows 'Defeated' for a run that was already won
where: src/view/hud/index.ts openPause()/afterPause('quit') (~lines 188-215): pause is allowed until ending is set by 'finished'; src/game/sim/sim.ts:464 abandon() is a no-op once phase is won/lost; openResult(env, false, true, ...)
repro: ?scene=battle&chapter=1&seed=7&sandbox=1&debug=1&lang=en&notitle=1, __dbg.battle.win() (battle.phase becomes 'won', the victory staging is still running and 'finished' has not fired). Tap Pause > Quit > confirm Quit. In a real run the same happens if the player pauses during the 3-8 s between the last kill and the result screen.
evidence: quit_after_win.png: Result screen titled 'Defeated' with 'You will do better next time.' while the stats beneath are those of a won run (28 summons, Seed 7) and PHASE printed 'won'. The result is built with victory=false and abandoned=true, then profile.finishRun receives the winning stats.
suggestion: Ignore/hide the pause button once battle.phase is 'won' or 'lost', or derive victory from battle.phase in the quit path.

title: Tutorial never tells a new player to keep summoning; a player who does only the scripted steps loses at wave 4 with fish unspent
where: Tutorial (?fresh=1), after the merge step; src/view/hud/Tutorial.ts, src/view/hud/tutorialFlow.ts
repro: Open ?fresh=1&lang=ko, wait for scenes.transitioning === false. Tap Summon 3 times (free), drag the two 솜방망이 together (forced merge step), then stop acting (only close hint bubbles). Step the sim with __dbg.battle.battle.step(0.05) and never summon. Log: wave 2 = 9 enemies, wave 3 = 33, wave 4 = 51 of 60, phase 'lost' at t=75 s with 197 fish unspent. Result screen says only '아쉬워요 / 다음엔 더 잘할 수 있어요' with no cause. The same flow with a natural policy (summon whenever fish >= cost, merge any pair) wins the tutorial at t=129 s, so the script itself is fine for an active player. The three forced steps end at the merge and nothing afterwards points at the Summon button; the cost label '12' has no pulse and wave 1 starts about 4.6 s after the third summon while the merge prompt is still showing, so the sim is not held (tutorialFlow.holding only suppresses hints, hud/index.ts:290).
evidence: t09_wave3_or_choice.png (wave 3 pick popup with 35/60 enemies, only 2 cats on board, 124 fish idle); t05_after3_later.png (after the third summon only the dim 'Summon 12' button, no prompt); t3p_end_a.png and t3p_end_c.png (tutorial defeat result '아쉬워요', wave 3/8, 4 summons); numbers from the API run printed in the session log (t0 w1 en2, t10 w2 en9, t22 w3 en33, t34 w4 en51, END lost w4 t75).
suggestion: After the merge step add a fourth soft step: when fish >= cost and the player has fewer than about 5 cats, pulse the Summon button with the pointer and a one-line bubble ('Fish ready - summon more!'). Optionally lower wave 1-3 counts in tutorial mode or give the tutorial the 'summon' reminder again at wave 2. On a tutorial defeat show the reason ('You had 197 fish left - spend them on cats').
